description: The NVIDIA app is the essential companion for PC gamers and creators. Keep your PC up to date with the latest NVIDIA drivers and technology.

script: if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { throw 'Run this from an admin shell.' }
$lockers = { Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { if ($_.Path -like "$appDir\*" -or ($_.Modules.FileName -like "$appDir\*")) { $_ } } catch {} } }

$stop = { Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Running' -and $_.PathName -like '*NVIDIA Corporation\NVIDIA App*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Service $_.Name -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; & $lockers | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# Remove a stale junction (link only, target untouched)
# Try: junction first so the installer writes straight into the Scoop dir
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $appDir -PathType Container)) { throw 'NVIDIA app installation failed: install folder not found.' }
# Fallback: installer replaced the junction (or an existing install was upgraded in place), so move it
throw "Could not remove original NVIDIA App folder. Locked by: $names"
if (!(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Force -Exclude 'setup.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1)) { throw 'No NVIDIA App files found in the Scoop dir.' }
